items.source: A RepositoryComposition represents an ordered collection of fragments. Each fragment contributes executable method signatures that are used by this composition to route method calls into the according RepositoryFragment.
items.translation: RepositoryComposition 表示一个有序的 片段 集合。每个片段提供可执行的方法签名，该组合利用这些签名将方法调用路由到相应的 RepositoryFragment。

items.source: Fragments are allowed to contribute multiple implementations for a single method signature exposed through the repository interface. MethodLookup selects the first matching method for invocation. A composition also supports argument conversion between the repository method signature and fragment implementation method through withArgumentConverter(BiFunction). Use argument conversion with a single implementation method that can be exposed accepting convertible types.
items.translation: 片段可以为通过存储库接口暴露的单个方法签名贡献多个实现。MethodLookup 会选择第一个匹配的方法进行调用。组合还支持通过 withArgumentConverter(BiFunction) 在存储库方法签名和片段实现方法之间进行参数转换。请使用参数转换功能，并配合一个可接受可转换类型的单一实现方法来使用。
